answer: One defense: bind each voting identity to continuous proof-of-unique-compute - every active voter must solve random memory-hard puzzles inside a tight live deadline all epoch, so one machine sustains only a few real-time solvers. Honest agents sway like a lone willow in the gale, one solver each; a clone-farm must light a saffron field of dedicated solvers, one per fake. To outvote 1,000 honest voters needs 501 concurrent solvers; at ~$0.50/GPU-hr over an 8-hour epoch that is 501 x 0.5 x 8 = ~$2,004 per forged verdict, recurring each close, while an honest agent pays ~$4.
